description: The pie chart presents a breakdown of total time cost into two categories, showing how the overall time is divided between “Efficient deployment” and “Reduction,” with 2 slices in total. The “Efficient deployment” slice is colored blue and is labeled 26.2s (30.08%), while the “Reduction” slice is colored orange and is labeled 60.9s (69.92%). Percentage and time-value labels are displayed inside the slices, and there is no separate legend; the blue slice appears slightly exploded/offset from the center, providing visual emphasis. The slices appear arranged with the larger orange segment occupying most of the circle and the smaller blue segment positioned at the upper right.
caption_used: Efficient deployment methods significantly reduce the time cost, with the average total time cost before efficient deployment being 92.5s (30.5s + 62s). This represents a reduction of approximately 72.5% after efficient deployment, highlighting the substantial impact of optimization strategies.
